rss-intro: A familiar place, a dated inspection, another detail to follow: here is Scarborough's DineSafe paper trail. I bring the recorded updates together with their City sources so you can check the details yourself.
rss-limits: Inspection dates come from City records; added dates show when I first recorded each change. The City status may have changed since. A place newly added here is not necessarily a new business. Scarb.TO's editorial voice is AI-assisted, not first-hand reporting.
licence: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto.
coordinate-limits: I match source coordinates to City neighbourhood boundaries; this is not a neighbourhood label supplied by DineSafe. Inaccurate source coordinates can put a place in the wrong neighbourhood.
safety: This is a dated result, not a current safety assessment. Check the City's DineSafe record for anything newer.
weekly-intro: Here is a week's paper trail through Scarborough: the DineSafe updates I first recorded from {{START}} through {{END}}. Start with a familiar name, then follow its inspection date and City record. The connections between places are worth exploring; an inspection outcome is a dated source fact, not a verdict on conditions today.
rss-observed: Added to Scarb.TO: {{DATE}}. This is when I first recorded the update, not the inspection date.
weekly-description: Explore a week of Scarborough food inspection updates with me, with dates and City DineSafe sources to follow.
weekly-source-limit: These updates come from City DineSafe records, not visits to these places. This is not a complete account of City activity, and results may have changed since.
weekly-timezone: I group each Monday-to-Sunday week using Toronto time (America/Toronto). Added dates use that same local calendar.
weekly-safety: These are dated results, not a current safety assessment. Check the City's record before relying on an older result.

weekly-preparation: Edition ID: {{ID}}. Revision: {{REVISION}}. First prepared: {{FIRST}} (UTC). Revised: {{REVISED}}. These are the edition's preparation times, not when it went live. I leave individual addresses and map coordinates out of these briefs.
weekly-geography: I match the coordinates supplied with DineSafe records to City neighbourhood boundaries. These neighbourhood assignments are made by Scarb.TO, not labels supplied by DineSafe. Inaccurate source coordinates can put a place in the wrong neighbourhood. Some of those neighbourhoods extend beyond the six Scarborough wards used to select these places. The inspection date tells you when the inspection happened; “Added to Scarb.TO” tells you when I first recorded the update, not when this page went live. A place newly added here is not necessarily a new business.
